```yaml
name: CI & Security

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]
  release:
    types: [published]

jobs:
  release:
    if: github.event_name == 'release'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org/'
          always-auth: true
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Publish packages with provenance
        run: npx changeset publish --provenance
        env:
          NODE_AUTH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

  scorecard:
    if: github.event_name != 'release'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Verify SPDX license
        run: |
          echo "Checking license field in package.json files..."
          mismatches=$(find . -name package.json -exec grep -H '"license":' {} \; | grep -v '"license": "MIT"')
          if [ -n "$mismatches" ]; then
            echo "Found non-MIT license entries:"
            echo "$mismatches"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Run OpenSSF Scorecard
        uses: ossf/scorecard-action@v1.0.0
        with:
          repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          output: scorecard.json

      - name: Upload Scorecard Report
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: scorecard-report
          path: scorecard.json
```
